agents.description: Use when the user wants to challenge assumptions, break down a complex problem from scratch, or approach something with first principles reasoning. Triggers on: 'first principles', 'challenge assumptions', 'why do we do it this way', 'rethink', 'from scratch', 'fundamental truths'.

agents.name: israel-market-researcher
agents.description: Use this agent when researching the Israeli market: consumers, competitors, regulation, pricing in ILS, Hebrew/Russian-speaking audiences and local channels.

agents.name: market-researcher
agents.description: Use this agent when you need to analyze markets, understand consumer behavior, assess competitive landscapes, and size opportunities to inform business strategy and market entry decisions.

agents.name: news-digest-monitor
agents.description: Use this agent when preparing a news digest on a topic: recent developments, sources, dates and why each item matters.

agents.name: open-source-scout
agents.description: Use this agent when looking for open-source projects to reuse: finding GitHub repositories, checking activity, licence, security and how to integrate them as packages.

agents.name: patent-researcher
agents.description: Use this agent when searching patents and prior art: claims analysis, classification codes, freedom-to-operate notes and patent landscapes.

agents.name: policy-regulation-researcher
agents.description: Use this agent when researching laws, regulations and standards that affect a product: requirements, deadlines and obligations with official sources.

agents.name: price-monitoring-analyst
agents.description: Use this agent when tracking prices of products or services across sellers: comparison tables, changes over time and alerts.

agents.name: project-idea-validator
agents.description: Use this agent when you need an idea pressure-tested with brutal honesty, competitor teardown, market validation, and clear go/no-go guidance before building.

agents.name: research-analyst
agents.description: Use this agent when you need comprehensive research across multiple sources with synthesis of findings into actionable insights, trend identification, and detailed reporting.

agents.name: scientific-literature-researcher
agents.description: Use when you need to search scientific literature and retrieve structured experimental data from published studies. Invoke this agent when the task requires evidence-grounded answers from full-text research papers, including methods, results, sample sizes, and quality scores.
agents.note: needs the 'bgpt' MCP server (mcp__bgpt__search_papers, external service bgpt.pro); without it only WebSearch/WebFetch

agents.name: search-specialist
agents.description: Use when you need to find specific information across multiple sources using advanced search strategies, query optimization, and targeted information retrieval. Invoke this agent when the priority is locating precise, relevant results efficiently rather than analyzing or synthesizing content.

agents.name: sentiment-analyst
agents.description: Use this agent when analysing opinions in reviews, social posts or support tickets: sentiment, topics, trends and representative examples.

agents.name: statistics-consultant
agents.description: Use this agent when a question needs the right statistical method: test selection, sample size, regression, confidence intervals and interpretation.

agents.name: supply-chain-risk-analyst
agents.description: Use this agent when assessing supply chain risks: supplier concentration, lead times, geopolitical and logistics disruptions and mitigations.

agents.name: survey-designer
agents.description: Use this agent when designing surveys and questionnaires: unbiased questions, scales, sampling and analysis plans.

agents.name: tech-stack-evaluator
agents.description: Use this agent when choosing technologies: comparing frameworks, databases or services on maturity, community, licence, performance and fit.

agents.name: trend-analyst
agents.description: Use when analyzing emerging patterns, predicting industry shifts, or developing future scenarios to inform strategic planning and competitive positioning.

agents.name: user-interview-synthesizer
agents.description: Use this agent when synthesising user interviews: coding notes, themes, quotes, jobs-to-be-done and opportunity areas.

agents.name: web-researcher
agents.description: Use this agent when you need facts gathered from live websites — prices, documentation, release notes, listings, official announcements — with every claim tied to the page it came from.
agents.note: prefers the browser_use runtime (local Chromium) or Claude Code with WebSearch/WebFetch

agents.name: agent-installer
agents.description: Use this agent when the user wants to discover, browse, or install Claude Code agents from the awesome-claude-code-subagents repository.
agents.note: disabled: downloads unreviewed agent files from VoltAgent/awesome-claude-code-subagents; kept in library/disabled/
